description.zh:
实例的角色类型。取值：
- **db**: shard角色
- **cs**：config server角色
- **mongos**：mongos角色
- **logic**：分片集群实例
description.en:
The role of the instance. Valid values:

- **db**: shard

- **cs**: Configserver

- **mongos**: mongos

- **logic**: sharded cluster instance

description.zh:
实例ID。
> 当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入**NodeId**参数。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the **NodeId** parameter.

description.zh: 查询结束时间。必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID。

> 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用。
description.en:
The ID of the mongos node or shard node whose parameter modification records you want to query in the instance.

> This parameter is valid only when **DBInstanceId** is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

title.zh: 查询实例参数的修改记录

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-parameter-modification-history --db-instance-id dds-bp22350000 --node-id d-bp11580000 --start-time 2019-01-01T12:10Z --end-time 2019-01-02T12:10Z --character-type mongos --region cn-hangzhou
